caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a reddish-brown hue. The chair has a tall, decorative backrest featuring a central splat with a curved, symmetrical design, bordered by two straight vertical posts that extend upward and curve outward at the top. The seat is flat and rectangular, appearing slightly padded and colored in a matching reddish tone. The chair has four legs: the front two legs are cabriole-shaped with outward curves and slight scrolls at the feet, while the rear legs are straight and extend vertically down from the seat. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects present.
title: Side Chair
